info.about: Persona 3, released outside Japan as Shin Megami Tensei: Persona 3, is a 2006 role-playing video game developed by Atlus. It is the fourth main installment in the Persona series, which is part of the larger Megami Tensei franchise.
info.trivia: FES added an epilogue campaign, The Answer, that is harder than the entire base game and has no social links.
info.why: The Atlus print run was modest and the series' audience multiplied years later.
